label: Baseline
hypothesis: Freeze the original thresholded writer and recency-based retrieval.
predicted_effect: Useful direct facts work; entity and temporal ambiguity remain visible.

proposer.name: Codex
proposer.attribution: Authored by Codex while building this demo, with public access to all scenarios; no runtime provider call.

label: Agent proposal 1
hypothesis: Enabling entity and as-of-date filtering will prevent cross-entity distractors and exclude records outside the requested validity interval, improving complete-scenario task success without changing admission or ownership behavior.
predicted_effect: Entity-grounding and distractor-retrieval should select the requested entity; historical-address, future-move, and history-boundary should select the record valid at the requested as-of date. Hard-constraint behavior should remain unchanged.

label: Agent proposal 2
hypothesis: Enabling deduplication will reuse identical active values, reducing stored records and duplicate retrieval distraction while preserving answers and hard-constraint behavior.
predicted_effect: Duplicate-confirmation should retain the correct German answer with fewer records; overall task success and write precision should remain unchanged or improve, while storage_records and likely distraction decrease.

label: Agent proposal 3
hypothesis: Lowering min_confidence from 0.7 to 0.6 will admit the demonstrated useful low-confidence fact while preserving abstention for the 0.3 and 0.4 cases, improving complete-scenario success without changing retrieval isolation or deduplication behavior.
predicted_effect: The useful-low-confidence scenario should answer Portuguese rather than null. Clean abstention and uncertain-conflict should remain unchanged, with no expected hard-constraint impact; storage may increase only for genuinely admitted 0.6-scored facts.
